snippet.title: Kill the Thing   Trailer
snippet.description:
Keep the corruption under control while searching for its origin!

Kill The Thing is a challenging turn-based tactical RPG with no hit-chance rng, deep combos, positioning and status effects. .

Check out the demo and whislist on Steam!
